name: Frost Giant Ghost

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Death’s Chill
traits.details: Any creature that ends its turn in the aura takes 10 cold and necrotic damage unless it allows the ghost to slide it up to 3 squares.

traits.name: Corpsebound
traits.details: The ghost cannot voluntarily move more than 20 squares from its remains. If the ghost is forced beyond this range, it is weakened and unable to use ghostly possession until it moves back within range.

traits.name: Insubstantial
traits.details: The ghost takes half damage from all attacks, except those that deal force damage. Whenever the ghost takes radiant damage, it loses this trait until the start of its next turn.

auras.name: Death’s Chill
auras.details: Any creature that ends its turn in the aura takes 10 cold and necrotic damage unless it allows the ghost to slide it up to 3 squares.

effect.description: The ghost uses death’s touch twice.

hit.description: The ghost is removed from play, and the target is dominated (save ends). When the target is no longer dominated, the ghost reappears in a space of its choice adjacent to the target. The ghost can voluntarily end this effect at the end of its turn.
cold and necrotic damage, the ghost pushes the target up to 4 squares, and the target falls prone.

miss.description: Half damage, and the ghost pushes the target up to 2 squares.
